= Plate (plate)
:page-toclevels: 2
:description: Bending of a flat plate under loads normal to it (Reissner-Mindlin, thin and moderately thick): stationary and eigenfrequencies
:page-math: true

Bending of a flat plate under loads normal to it (Reissner-Mindlin, thin and moderately thick): stationary and eigenfrequencies. The 2D geometry is the midsurface. Elmer SmitcSolver.

[cols="1,3"]
|===
|Category |Structural Mechanics
|Name (tag) |`+plate+`
|Space dimensions |2D
|Studies |Stationary, Eigenfrequency
|Dependent variables |`+wp+` Deflection (`+m+`), `+thx+` Rotation of the normal, x (`+rad+`), `+thy+` Rotation of the normal, y (`+rad+`)
|Default features |<<plate-lemm,Linear Elastic Material>>, <<plate-free,Free>>
|===

latexmath:[D\,\nabla^4 w = q,\quad D=\frac{E h^3}{12(1-\nu^2)}]

Material properties used: Young's modulus (E), Poisson's ratio (ν), Density (ρ).

== Boundary features

[#plate-clamped]
=== Fixed Constraint

Clamped edge: no deflection and no rotation of the normal.

Selection: Boundaries · Physics ribbon › Boundaries, or right-click the interface in the Model Builder

latexmath:[w = 0,\quad \boldsymbol{\theta} = \mathbf{0}]

No settings.

[#plate-simple]
=== Simply Supported

No deflection; the edge is free to rotate (soft simple support).

Selection: Boundaries · Physics ribbon › Boundaries, or right-click the interface in the Model Builder

latexmath:[w = 0,\quad M_n = 0]

No settings.

[#plate-disp]
=== Prescribed Deflection/Rotation

θx and θy are the slopes of the deflection that the normal follows: θx = ∂w/∂x and θy = ∂w/∂y in a thin plate.

Selection: Boundaries · Physics ribbon › Boundaries, or right-click the interface in the Model Builder

latexmath:[w = w_0,\quad \theta_x = \theta_{x0},\quad \theta_y = \theta_{y0}]
